composition.alignment: Strong left alignment with an offset image block
composition.whitespace: High — large outer margins and generous subject breathing room
composition.density: Medium-low visual density; information remains compact
composition.focal_points: One dominant headline, then the image
composition.spatial_rhythm: Large-to-small spacing contrast creates a calm reading tempo

color.strategy: Warm ivory field + muted navy text + one mustard accent

typography.headline: Large editorial serif; high stroke contrast; confident scale
typography.body: Small modern sans-serif; regular weight; restrained tracking
typography.hierarchy: Strong size contrast between display type and metadata

texture.image_treatment: Soft contrast, muted saturation, restrained sharpness

mood.label: Calm
mood.because: low saturation + generous whitespace + soft contrast

mood.label: Editorial
mood.because: asymmetric grid + serif display type + print-like texture

why_it_works: The design feels premium because it is restrained rather than decorative. A limited warm-neutral palette keeps visual noise low, while the oversized serif headline establishes an immediate hierarchy. The asymmetric grid prevents the page from feeling generic, and generous negative space gives both the type and image room to breathe.
